title: Tools, Metrics and Selection Criteria
subtitle: Find a real market gap: low competition, profitable demand

items.title: DA and PA
items.text: Moz authority, for the site and for the page

items.title: DR and RD
items.text: Ahrefs backlink strength; low RD on a competitor is a weakness

items.title: Volume and KD
items.text: Keyword Everywhere volume; KD via Moz or SEMrush

items.title: Trend above 30
items.text: Google Trends score, seasonal or evergreen

columns.title: Choose
items: Specific, problem-solving topics ("Tim Hortons Menu", not "Menus")
At least 3 SERP sites with DA under 20
Micro or nano niches, expand later
Under 100 to 150 pages for an informational site
No AI Overview, or a search-intent mismatch

columns.title: Avoid
items: Single-word niches: Motivation, Beauty, Food, Samsung, Sports
Judging competition beyond page 1 of the SERP
Trusting one metrics provider as ground truth
Competitors with high DR and RD

sections.quote: Always sanity-check a metric against a second source.
sections.text: No single metrics provider is treated as ground truth.
